name: Procure-to-Pay
description: A four-phase Procure-to-Pay process: a business unit raises a requisition, finance validates the budget, procurement selects a vendor and raises a purchase order, and accounts payable matches and settles the invoice. Seeded with five known gaps so the Gaps register has something to work on straight away.

sipoc.process: A business unit raises a purchase requisition, the budget owner validates funding, procurement reviews the requisition and selects a vendor, a manager approves the spend, procurement issues a purchase order, the vendor delivers, and accounts payable matches the invoice against the order and the receipt before paying on NET-30 terms.

teams.name: Requestor
teams.description: The business unit that raises the requisition and confirms delivery

teams.name: Procurement
teams.description: Sources vendors, negotiates terms, and raises purchase orders

teams.name: Budget Owner
teams.description: Owns the cost centre and approves the spend

teams.name: IT/Integrations
teams.description: Automated routing and the ERP integrations the process depends on

teams.name: Vendor
teams.description: The external supplier of the goods or services

teams.name: Accounts Payable
teams.description: Matches invoices to orders and receipts, and settles them

systems.name: ERP
systems.description: System of record for budgets, purchase orders, and goods receipts

systems.name: Procurement Portal
systems.description: Where requisitions are raised, routed, and approved

systems.name: AP Automation
systems.description: Captures vendor invoices and runs the three-way match

systems.name: Banking Portal
systems.description: Releases the payment run to the bank

milestones.name: Requisition
milestones.description: The need is written down and funded before anyone talks to a vendor

milestones.name: Approval
milestones.description: Procurement reviews the requisition, picks a vendor, and the spend is approved

milestones.name: Purchase Order
milestones.description: The commitment is raised, posted to the ERP, and delivered against

milestones.name: Payment
milestones.description: Receipt, invoice, and order are matched before money moves

steps.label: Create Purchase Requisition
steps.trigger: A team identifies a need that existing stock or contracts cannot meet
steps.result: A draft requisition with line items, quantities, and a cost centre
steps.kpi: Requisitions accepted without rework on first submission

steps.label: Submit for Budget Check
steps.trigger: The requestor marks the draft complete
steps.result: The requisition leaves the requestor's queue and lands with the budget owner
steps.kpi: Time from draft created to submitted

steps.label: Validate Budget
steps.trigger: A submitted requisition arrives in the budget owner's queue
steps.result: The requested amount is checked against the remaining cost-centre allocation
steps.kpi: Requisitions validated within one working day
steps.notes: Checked by hand against the ERP today — see the budget validation gap.

steps.label: Confirm Budget Availability
steps.trigger: The budget check returns a result
steps.result: Funds are earmarked against the cost centre and the requisition is released to procurement
steps.kpi: Share of requisitions funded without a budget transfer

steps.label: Route to Procurement
steps.trigger: A requisition is marked budget-approved
steps.result: The portal assigns the requisition to a procurement category buyer
steps.kpi: Requisitions routed to the correct buyer first time
steps.notes: Automated routing rule in the Procurement Portal, not a person.

steps.label: Review Purchase Requisition
steps.trigger: A requisition lands in the buyer's queue
steps.result: Specification, quantity, and category are confirmed or sent back for detail
steps.kpi: Requisitions returned to the requestor for clarification

steps.label: Select Vendor
steps.trigger: A reviewed requisition needs a source of supply
steps.result: A vendor is chosen from the approved list, or a new vendor is proposed
steps.kpi: Spend placed with approved vendors

steps.label: Negotiate Terms
steps.trigger: A vendor is selected
steps.result: Price, delivery date, and payment terms are agreed with the vendor
steps.kpi: Savings against the requisition's estimated value

steps.label: Manager Approval
steps.trigger: Negotiated terms are submitted for sign-off
steps.result: Approved requisitions are released to procurement to raise the order; rejected ones return to the requestor for rework
steps.kpi: Approval turnaround from submission to decision

steps.label: Release Approved Requisition
steps.trigger: A manager records an approval decision
steps.result: The approved requisition is released to procurement to raise the order
steps.kpi: Approved requisitions released the same day

steps.label: Create Purchase Order
steps.trigger: An approved requisition is released to procurement
steps.result: A purchase order is raised against the approved vendor and terms
steps.kpi: Purchase orders raised without amendment

steps.label: Sync Purchase Order to Accounting System
steps.trigger: A purchase order is raised in the portal
steps.result: The commitment is posted against the cost centre in the ERP
steps.kpi: Purchase orders posted to the ERP within the hour
steps.notes: The nightly job that carries this is the source of the accounting sync gap.

steps.label: Issue Purchase Order to Vendor
steps.trigger: The purchase order is posted to the ERP
steps.result: The vendor receives the order and the agreed terms in writing
steps.kpi: Orders issued within one day of approval

steps.label: Acknowledge Purchase Order
steps.trigger: The vendor receives a purchase order
steps.result: The vendor confirms price, quantity, and a delivery date
steps.kpi: Orders acknowledged within two working days

steps.label: Deliver Goods or Services
steps.trigger: The vendor acknowledges the order
steps.result: Goods or services arrive at the requesting business unit with a delivery note
steps.kpi: Deliveries on or before the acknowledged date

steps.label: Record Goods Receipt
steps.trigger: Goods or services arrive at the business unit
steps.result: Receipt is recorded against the purchase order line, quantity by quantity
steps.kpi: Receipts recorded within two days of delivery

steps.label: Receive Vendor Invoice
steps.trigger: A vendor invoice arrives against an open purchase order
steps.result: The invoice is captured and registered against the order
steps.kpi: Invoices captured without manual keying

steps.label: Perform Three-Way Match
steps.trigger: An invoice is registered against a purchase order
steps.result: Order, receipt, and invoice are compared; exceptions are held for query
steps.kpi: Invoices matching on first pass

steps.label: Schedule Payment on NET-30 Terms
steps.trigger: An invoice clears the three-way match
steps.result: The invoice joins a payment run dated to the agreed terms
steps.kpi: Invoices paid on terms rather than early or late

steps.label: Execute Payment and Close Purchase Order
steps.trigger: A payment run reaches its scheduled date
steps.result: The vendor is paid, remittance is sent, and the purchase order is closed
steps.kpi: Purchase orders closed within a week of final payment

policies.title: Purchases over $5,000 require manager approval
policies.content: Any requisition with a total value above $5,000 must be approved by the cost-centre owner before a purchase order is raised. Requisitions at or below the threshold are approved by the category buyer.
policies.testNotes: Raise a requisition for $5,001 and confirm it cannot reach Purchase Order without a recorded manager decision.

policies.title: Vendors must be on the approved vendor list
policies.content: Procurement may only place an order with a vendor that has completed onboarding and appears on the approved vendor list. A new vendor must be onboarded before the order is raised, not after.
policies.testNotes: Attempt to select a vendor that is not on the list and confirm the requisition is held.

policies.title: Payment terms default to NET-30
policies.content: Unless a contract states otherwise, vendor invoices are scheduled for payment thirty days from invoice date. Shorter terms require the budget owner's agreement at negotiation, not at payment.
policies.testNotes: Check that a matched invoice with no contract override schedules thirty days out.

gaps.observed: A buyer can select a vendor that has never been onboarded. Onboarding is chased by email after the order is placed, and bank details are collected at invoice time.
gaps.expected: A documented vendor onboarding process gates selection: no vendor reaches the approved list without verified bank details, tax status, and a signed agreement.
gaps.fixIdea: Write the onboarding standard, then make the approved vendor list the only selectable source in the portal.

gaps.observed: The budget owner opens the ERP and compares the requisition total against the remaining allocation by hand. Nothing stops a requisition that exceeds it.
gaps.expected: The portal checks the requisition against the live cost-centre balance and flags an overspend before it reaches procurement.
gaps.fixIdea: Call the ERP budget endpoint from the portal's submit action and block on a hard overspend.

gaps.observed: The routing rule assigns by spend category, but the category list has not been reviewed in two years. Buyers reassign roughly a fifth of requisitions by hand.
gaps.expected: Routing rules are documented, owned, and reviewed, so a requisition reaches the right buyer without reassignment.
gaps.fixIdea: Publish the routing matrix, give it an owner, and review it quarterly against reassignment counts.

gaps.observed: The portal-to-ERP sync runs nightly and fails silently on orders with more than twenty lines. Finance finds the missing commitments at month end.
gaps.expected: Every purchase order posts to the ERP within the hour, and a failed post raises an alert rather than passing quietly.
gaps.fixIdea: Batch long orders, and fail the job loudly with a retry queue instead of swallowing the error.

gaps.observed: A rejected requisition returns to the requestor with no record of who rejected it, when, or why. The reason lives in whatever email followed.
gaps.expected: Every approval decision, rejection included, is stamped with approver, timestamp, and reason, and is readable from the requisition.
gaps.fixIdea: Make the rejection reason a required field and write the decision to the requisition's history.

glossary.definition: An internal request to buy something. It is not a commitment to a vendor — that is the purchase order.
The document that commits the organisation to buy from a named vendor at agreed terms. Legally binding once acknowledged.
The record that what was ordered actually arrived, line by line. One of the three documents in the three-way match.
Comparing the purchase order, the goods receipt, and the vendor invoice before paying. A mismatch on any pair holds the invoice.
Payment terms meaning the invoice is due thirty days from its date.
